title: Certificates of Deposit: When a Penalty Departs From the Term's Rate or Days, and the Sum Credited Back
content:
This page states, for Certificates of Deposit, how the comparison between a booked early withdrawal penalty and the figures the certificate terms fix is decided, and exactly what sum is credited back when the two part company.

## When a booked penalty departs from the terms

A penalty departs from the terms if either of these is true:

- the rate shown as applied on the penalty entry differs from the rate the terms fix for the term by more than 0.001 of a percentage point; or
- the penalty days shown on the entry are not equal to the prescribed penalty days.

Either difference on its own is enough. A rate gap of 0.001 of a point or less is treated as agreement.

## The sum credited back

A departing penalty is credited back for the whole sum booked on its entry, never for part of it. Nothing is recomputed or re-rounded: the credit repeats, cent for cent, the sum on the entry.

A credit is written only when all of these hold together: the penalty departs from the terms; it was posted in the certificate's current term; it does not sit in the grace window after maturity; no reversal has yet been recorded against it; and its booked sum is above zero. In every other case nothing is written; in particular, a penalty that agrees with the terms on both rate and days is left alone.

## Truth table (hypothetical penalty in the current term, outside grace, not yet reversed)

| Booked rate compared with the rate the terms fix | Booked days compared with prescribed days | Credit written |
|---|---|---|
| Equal | Equal | Nothing |
| Differs by 0.0005 of a point | Equal | Nothing |
| Differs by 0.15 of a point | Equal | The whole booked sum |
| Equal | Differs | The whole booked sum |
| Differs by 0.15 of a point | Differs | The whole booked sum, once |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A penalty entry shows USD 212.47, a rate of 4.12 percent and 90 days; the rate the terms fix is 3.97 percent and the prescribed days are 90. The rates differ by 0.15 of a point, so the penalty departs from the terms, and the credit is USD 212.47, the sum booked on the entry.
